image_description: A close-up, top-down view of two feet wearing mismatched, hand-knitted wool socks. The left sock features horizontal stripes in warm tones (red, orange, yellow) transitioning to cool tones (blue, purple). The right sock has a similar striped pattern but with more muted, heathered colors and visible pilling/fuzz. Both socks have a ribbed cuff at the top. The feet are resting on a dark, textured surface, possibly a leather chair or car seat.
